preservedResponsibilities: Native FontMapExport preserves first raw family token, OpenSymbol/StarSymbol override, configured MS alternate and second-token fallback, retaining whitespace and UTF16 units. Native charset wrapper overrides only the original unknown/Unicode encoding cases. Actual unotools/SAL owners are consumed; native broader import/export/encoding helpers are unported.

Original private CanEncode and RTF font charset selection now use actual checked SAL byte-string conversion with the original cross-family 0x101 flags, Windows charset inversion, octet check, both primary/alternate names and exact MS932/MS936/MS950/MS949 fallback order/default1. A native byte-string scope supplies temporary ownership; no fake encoding provider or host codec is used. The source font-name algorithm is traced and directly tested but has not been independently compiled with full Writer/OUString/OString value classes. Native RTF font-table serialization remains pending.
omittedResponsibilities: Full native framework/ABI and complete format orchestration are not certified; see admission.
